Q: telegram api for USER rather than BOT A:

If Python is an option, Telethon https://codeberg.org/Lonami/Telethon is a well-documented MTProto library worth considering.

Q: Where can I find which actions are able to be executed against the different azure scopes? A:

This is expected. Azure OpenAI creation uses ARM deployment validation, which may require subscription-level permissions like Microsoft.Resources/deployments/validate/action. Check the Activity Log and compare your custom role with the built-in Contributor role to identify any missing actions.

Q: Transfer data from Cassandra to Postgressql A:

The only way to solve it is to develop your own app that can iterate across source result set and do the batch inserts to Cassandra. The fastest way to obtain data from Postgres is using CTID access method for the chunk spliting.

Q: smtp client throwing error message operation has timed out A:

Basically this problem happens when you are not able to connect to your SMTP server and that is why the timeout occurs. You are getting this message on because the default Timeout value of 100 seconds is being crossed.

There could be several issue why this problem could occur i.e. Wrong SMTP address, SMTP reject, Port setting, SSL configuration etc which you need to fix.

Q: Unexpected HTTP/1.x request: POST /3/device/XXXX A:

I had this same error until I switch the HTTP version

CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_2TLS
